note: The short text of a pattern (the fixed written part of its name, shown in the lesson rows) where the rule in scripts/pack-ja-names.mjs (shortTextRule) cannot make one: the fixed words are split by a placeholder, or a group of alternatives sits between them, or no fixed word is left but a form's name is not meant. 〜 marks where a placeholder was. Pattern id -> text. A pattern whose name is only a placeholder of a form (<verb potential form>) takes that form's name from pack-forms.json. A name made only of placeholders without a form (<number> + <counter>) is shown as it is without the angle brackets (number + counter).
